product.note: Parts only: screws and fittings aren’t shown, and sizes are approximate. Each step names the page of your paper manual to follow.

steps.title: Start with a rail and a panel
steps.instruction: Join a rail and a panel (A, B), as the animation shows. Page 3 of the IKEA manual shows this step.
checklist: A rail and a panel are joined

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the STIG bar stool. Page 3 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (rail, about 31 cm), B (panel, about 62 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 90 cm tall.
In 3 assembly videos, people took about 14 seconds on this step. Take your time.
